rows.en: Hmmm...
(Okay, time to head home.)

Wait, isn't that Klan-senpai?
What are you doing in a place like this?

Oh, if it isn't \p.
I'm not here for anything in particular.
I just dropped by on my way home from college.

Coming back to Mihoshi like this
brings back all sorts of memories...

The time Michel treated me like a child...
The time Michel teased me...
The time Michel made a fool of me...
(Every one of those memories is about Michel...)
Now even those are fond memories...
...Like heck they are!!!

Just remembering it is making me mad!
Where is Michel? I'll make him pay!

(Klan-senpai went off looking for Michel...
I'd better stop her rampage somehow.)
Waaait! Klan-senpai!!
(Every one of those memories is about Michel-kun...)

(Klan-senpai went off looking for Michel-kun...
I'd better stop her rampage somehow.)
Oh, if it isn't \p.

Remember how I tried to catch Michel
to pay him back for everything,
and he got away?

This time I'm lying in ambush here
so he can't escape.
(Klan-senpai's still hung up on that...)

Heh heh heh...
Prepare yourself, Michel!
Good luck, Klan-senpai...
(I'll be heading home ahead of you, though...)
(Klan-senpai's still hung up on that...)
(I'll be heading home ahead of you, though...)

(I came shopping in the Shibuya Area
with Klan-senpai, but...)

W-Well...
Even if you suddenly ask me
whether I'd like to be a model...
I need time to prepare myself...

(Who'd have thought Klan-senpai would get
scouted to model for a fashion magazine?)

What will you do, Klan-senpai?
Being a model is amazing!

Please, I'm begging you.
I don't think there's any girl better suited
to be our model this time than you.

R-Really...?
If you insist, I suppose I could do it...

Oh, th-thank you so much!
Now we have our child model too.
What a relief!
Huh?
...Ch-Child model?
Our magazine is for children's fashion.

Umm, you're her big brother, right?
Would you like to watch the shoot, too?
rows.notes: The scout takes the player for Klan's older brother (onii-san).

rows.en: U-Umm...
I am NOT a chiiiild!!!
(Oh, great. Klan-senpai got mad and went home...)
rows.notes: Source has no closing bracket (typo; the next row is still monologue); closing parenthesis added.

rows.en:
(Then again, I can kind of see
why people mistake her for a kid...)

Umm, you're her big sister, right?
Would you like to watch the shoot, too?
rows.notes: The scout takes the player for Klan's older sister (onee-san).

rows.en: (Oh, great. Klan-senpai got mad and went home...)
rows.notes: Source has no closing bracket (typo); closing parenthesis added.

rows.en:
Grrr... If anyone tries to recruit me as a model
again, I am absolutely not accepting!

(Klan-senpai's still hung up on what
happened last time...)

Klan-senpai, forget about that
and let's just have fun today.
Mm, y-yes... You're right.
No, but still...!

Come on, let's go,
Klan-senpai.

Grrr!!
I still can't forgive it!!!

(You're taking this way too hard,
Klan-senpai...)

(Klan-senpai's still hung up on what
happened last time...)

(Phew! I just barely made
the train to Folmo. Lucky me!)

Ugh, dammit!
Just a little more and I'll reach it...!

(Huh? It's Klan-senpai...
She's jumping with all her might.
What's she doing?)

Huff, huff, huff...
Hm? If it isn't \p.
Are you off somewhere to have fun?

Yes, I'm going shopping at Folmo.
What are you doing on the train, Senpai?
You looked like you were jumping like mad...

Th-That's... I was just trying
to grab a hand strap...

You don't have to push yourself like that.
There are free seats, so you could just sit...

A-Adults...
sometimes face battles they can't run from!
So I was boldly challenging the strap to a duel...

(Getting worked up over something like that
seems more childish, if you ask me...)

Dammit! I'm going to grab that strap
no matter what!

(I'm worried Klan-senpai
will miss her stop...)

(Huh? It's Klan-senpai...
She's jumping with all her might.
What's she doing?)

(I'm worried Klan-senpai
will miss her stop...)

(Huh? It's Klan-senpai...
She's jumping with all her might.
Don't tell me she's at it again...)

c08187: shared by narration, Klan, the player and Pinon (nml_pnn_021); 'Hmmm...' works for all.
